one_liner: Scan a Rubik's cube with the camera, get a guided solve, then drill finger tricks and algorithms with a trainer
target_user: casual cubers and learners stuck on solving or improving
core_job: camera cube state scan, step-by-step solve guidance, algorithm drills, solve timer
primary_interaction: scan cube -> follow guided solve -> practice drills -> track times
wedge_hypothesis: solvers exist but abandonware UI; trainer + scan in one local app with real drill loop is thin
